benefits.name: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% bonus on points earned on eligible stays.
benefits.terms: 25% bonus on base points earned on eligible stays.

benefits.name: 15 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 15 Elite Night Credits toward Marriott Bonvoy elite status each calendar year, stackable with nights earned from actual stays.

benefits.name: Free Night Award
benefits.description: Earn 1 Free Night Award, redeemable for a night at a participating hotel with a redemption level at or under 50,000 Marriott Bonvoy points, after spending $15,000 on eligible purchases on the card in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $15,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year. Can be topped up with up to 15,000 additional personal points for stays up to 75,000 points. Certain hotels charge resort fees not covered by the award.

benefits.name: 1,000 Bonus Points per Paid Stay
benefits.description: Earn 1,000 bonus Marriott Bonvoy points per paid eligible stay booked directly with Marriott at a participating hotel.
benefits.terms: Flat 1,000-point bonus per qualifying paid stay, not a multiplier on spend. Booked directly with Marriott.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $300 per trip for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed, up to 2 claims per 12-month period.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen checked and carry-on bags on trips paid for with the card.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars when the rental is paid for with the card and the rental company's collision damage waiver is declined.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against accidental damage or theft for 90 days.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.
Restaurants worldwide and U.S. supermarkets, combined, on up to $15,000 in purchases per calendar year; 2x thereafter.
